params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$src=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'HeavenBridgeRepo\heaven-bridge\worker.py'
$runtimeDir=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.mhw-local-tools'
$dst=Join-Path $runtimeDir 'heaven-desktop-worker.py'
$bak=Join-Path $runtimeDir 'heaven-desktop-worker.py.pre-v4.bak'
$python=(Get-Command python.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source
if(-not (Test-Path $src)){throw "Missing relay worker source: $src"}
$staged=Join-Path $runtimeDir 'heaven-desktop-worker.py.v4.new'
Copy-Item $src $staged -Force
& $python -m py_compile $staged
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'v4 staged worker failed syntax compile'}
if(Test-Path $dst){Copy-Item $dst $bak -Force}
$handoff=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'heaven-bridge-v4-handoff.ps1'
$body=@'
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
Start-Sleep -Seconds 6
$runtimeDir=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.mhw-local-tools'
$src=Join-Path $runtimeDir 'heaven-desktop-worker.py.v4.new'
$dst=Join-Path $runtimeDir 'heaven-desktop-worker.py'
$bak=Join-Path $runtimeDir 'heaven-desktop-worker.py.pre-v4.bak'
$pythonw=(Get-Command pythonw.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source
$log=Join-Path (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'HeavenBridge') 'v4-handoff.log'
try {
  Copy-Item $src $dst -Force
  $workers=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -like '*\.mhw-local-tools\heaven-desktop-worker.py*' })
  foreach($w in $workers){ try { Stop-Process -Id $w.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction Stop } catch {} }
  Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
  $new=Start-Process -WindowStyle Hidden -FilePath $pythonw -ArgumentList ('"'+$dst+'"') -WorkingDirectory $env:USERPROFILE -PassThru
  Start-Sleep -Seconds 5
  if(-not (Get-Process -Id $new.Id -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)){ throw 'v4 worker exited during startup window' }
  ('V4_HANDOFF_OK pid='+$new.Id+' at='+(Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o')) | Set-Content -LiteralPath $log -Encoding UTF8
} catch {
  ('V4_HANDOFF_FAILED '+$_.Exception.Message+' at='+(Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o')) | Set-Content -LiteralPath $log -Encoding UTF8
  if(Test-Path $bak){
    Copy-Item $bak $dst -Force
    Start-Process -WindowStyle Hidden -FilePath $pythonw -ArgumentList ('"'+$dst+'"') -WorkingDirectory $env:USERPROFILE | Out-Null
  }
}
'@
Set-Content -LiteralPath $handoff -Value $body -Encoding UTF8
Start-Process -WindowStyle Hidden -FilePath powershell.exe -ArgumentList @('-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File',$handoff) | Out-Null
Write-Output 'V4_HANDOFF_SCHEDULED'
Write-Output ('SOURCE_SHA256='+(Get-FileHash $staged -Algorithm SHA256).Hash)
